verdict.rationale: Fly.io is a compute platform built on Machines and Sprites, so it is fair to ask about execution time limits. None of the evidence documents CPU-time or wall-clock limits, or says whether long-running workloads have no cap. The Sprite and Machine lifecycle claims (sleep/wake, restart policy) describe related behavior, not documented execution limits.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know the CPU and wall-clock execution time limits for functions so I can tell whether long-running or agentic workloads will fit
